items.caption:
Don't use the system unless you're ready for clients to start chasing you. Machine transcript wording.
Lara Acosta | Send & Sell LinkedIn and email workflow
Reverse warning → remove resistance → claimed proof → attention and conversion → five day calendar → email bridge → welcome sequence → event invitation.
Creator claims over $2.5 million in less than three years without a sales call and shows a financial screenshot. Not independently verified.
CTA: Comment EVENT for a link to a free online event. Delivery and registration path not inspected.
Lesson: Separate LinkedIn attention from email conversion. Reuse five post ideas as longer emails with relevant offer invitations.
items.transcript: Don't use the system unless you're ready for clients to start chasing you. Machine transcript wording.

notionMeta.painOrDesire: Attract clients without uncomfortable sales calls or constant pitching.
notionMeta.promise: Source promises a LinkedIn and email system for attracting clients. Outcome is not verified.
notionMeta.objectionHandling: Addresses dislike of selling and pitching; substitutes an inbound content/email system. Personal revenue claim acts as reassurance, not verified proof. Traffic requirements, list conversion, offer fit and effort remain unexplained.
notionMeta.lesson: Separate LinkedIn attention from email conversion. Reuse five post ideas as longer emails with relevant offer invitations.
